## How AMSI hooks PowerShell

PowerShell loads `amsi.dll` into its process and calls `AmsiScanBuffer` on script content before execution. The CLR exposes the AMSI context through `System.Management.Automation.AmsiUtils` (non-public). Three reliable attack surfaces exist in memory:
